    SELECT 
        T2.name AS name,
        T3.balance AS average_savings_balance,
        T4.balance AS average_checking_balance
    FROM 
        accounts AS T1 
    JOIN 
        savings AS T2 ON T1.custid = T2.custid 
    JOIN 
        (SELECT AVG(balance) AS average_savings_balance FROM savings) AS T3 
    JOIN 
        (SELECT AVG(balance) AS average_checking_balance FROM checking) AS T4 
) AS T5

    T3.average_checking_balance < T5.average_checking_balance AND 
    T4.average_savings_balance > T5.average_savings_balance
